Lantana Consulting Group, Inc. provides services and software for standards-based health-information exchange. We have established ourselves as a trusted leader in the industry with two decades of expertise in developing and deploying technical specifications and interoperability solutions. As a rapidly growing distributed, employee-owned company, we hire exceptional talent nationwide and offer flexible remote work arrangements. We take pride in our mission to improve public health and quality of care.
  
  
**Primary Purpose**
Provides data analysis and public-health expertise to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s (CDC’s) National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN), with a focus on digital quality measures (dQMs), bed-capacity initiatives, and other emerging analytical needs. Applies established analytic methods to healthcare data; assesses data quality; and collaborates with technical, clinical, and public-health teams regarding analysis, validation, and implementation activities. Leverages analytical expertise and public-health knowledge to provide actionable insights.
  
  
**A Successful Candidate Will Do The Following**

* Use Python or R and follow established analytic workflows to access, integrate, clean, transform, and analyze healthcare data from multiple sources
* Perform routine data-quality assessments, investigate anomalies, validate results, and contribute to reproducible quality-control checks and automated workflows
* Apply standard statistical and analytic methods to defined questions; interpret, summarize, and communicate findings and data limitations
* Analyze clinical and operational healthcare data, including HL7 FHIR-based data, to support quality measurement, surveillance, and operational reporting initiatives
* Evaluate common data issues involving FHIR–EHR mapping, clinical terminology, patient identity, and encounter information; document findings and seek guidance on complex issues
* Support testing and validation of dQM specifications, NHSN analytic outputs, and related applications; document test results and communicate issues to project and development teams
* Write, document, and maintain clear analytic code; use established version-control practices; and troubleshoot routine programming issues
* Collaborate with clinical experts, software developers, and other team members to refine analytic approaches and improve processes
* Prepare concise written summaries, visualizations, project updates, and presentations for technical and nontechnical audiences
* Manage assigned tasks and timelines independently, follow through on deliverables, and escalate questions or risks when appropriate
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant public-health practices, healthcare data standards, and developments in digital quality measurement

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree and at least six (6) years of relevant experience in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, mathematics, or related field; or master’s degree and at least four (4) years of relevant experience
* Proficiency using Python or R to import, manipulate, clean, and analyze data and validate results
* Experience working with large or complex data sets, integrating data from multiple sources, and performing data-quality checks
* Ability to carry out routine analytic and programming assignments with limited oversight
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills,
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills
